# qweave v0.6.2

[中文](https://github.com/GaomingOrion/qweave/blob/v0.6.2/.github/release-notes/v0.6.2.md)

This release adds six computation operators for Qlib migration, retaining
Float64 inputs and mask outputs.

## Changes

- Added inequality `x != y`: returns 1.0/0.0, or NaN if either input is NaN.
- Added logical AND, OR, and NOT: `x & y`, `x | y`, and `~x`. Positive values
  are true, zero and negative values are false, and NaN/null is unknown.
  False AND unknown is false; true OR unknown is true; other indeterminate
  results are NaN. These are three-valued logical operations, not integer
  bitwise operations. Masks can still participate in multiplication and rolling sums.
- Added `x.ts_mad(N)`: mean absolute deviation about the same window's mean,
  requiring a full finite window. Constant windows yield 0; NaN/null/infinity
  yields NaN. Each window is calculated without a temporary array allocation.
- Added `x.ts_count(N)`: counts non-NaN/null samples after N rows, including
  zero and infinities. Full all-missing windows yield 0. Incremental updates
  take O(T) total time.
- All six support tree and DAG execution; logical operators also support
  fusion and constant folding. Rust constructors are `alpha::ne`, `and`,
  `or`, `not`, `ts_mad`, and `ts_count`.
- Both new rolling operators omit `min_periods`: the first N−1 rows are NaN,
  N=0 yields NaN throughout, and negative/noninteger periods are rejected.
  Qlib's partial-window warmup behavior still differs.

## Stricter Python truth testing

`bool(expr)`, `if expr`, Python `and/or/not`, and chained comparisons now raise
`TypeError`, preventing unevaluated expressions from silently acting as truth
values. Use parenthesized comparisons with `&`, `|`, and `~`, and continue
wrapping constants in `qw.lit(...)`:

```python
mask = (qw.col("close") > qw.col("open")) & (qw.col("volume") != qw.lit(0.0))
alpha = mask.ts_sum(20).alias("up_days")
```

See the [expression API](https://github.com/GaomingOrion/qweave/blob/v0.6.2/docs/expression_api.en.md)
and [Qlib migration reference](https://github.com/GaomingOrion/qweave/blob/v0.6.2/docs/qlib_operators.en.md)
for full semantics.

## Installation

```powershell
python -m pip install --upgrade qweave==0.6.2
```

Python 3.10+ is supported, with stable-ABI wheels for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
